en.headline: Tesla driver dies after collision on Island Eastern Corridor
en.dek: 54-year-old man found unconscious with no superficial injuries; police investigating possible medical episode while driving.
body: Police are investigating the death of a 54-year-old man who was driving a Tesla that collided with two other private cars on the Island Eastern Corridor on Saturday morning.

Officers received a report at about 10.37am that the man was driving westbound near the North Point Ferry Concourse when he was suspected to have lost control and collided with the other vehicles. He was found unconscious with no superficial injuries and was taken to Ruttonjee Hospital, where he was certified dead at 12.08pm.

A traffic police officer who witnessed the incident from the opposite direction turned around, administered artificial respiration for about three minutes and later escorted the ambulance. Preliminary information suggested the driver may have suffered a medical episode while at the wheel, leaving the vehicle uncontrolled.

The Hong Kong Island Traffic Special Investigation Team is handling the case. Anyone with information is asked to contact officers on 3660 6838 or 3660 6849. Some Central-bound lanes near the pier were temporarily closed, causing congestion.

zh.headline: 東區走廊Tesla司機撞車後不治 警查是否駕駛時不適
zh.dek: 54歲男子昏迷送院，無表面傷痕；初步不排除暈倒後車輛失控。
body: 警方正調查一宗交通意外，一名54歲男子駕駛Tesla電動車於東區走廊西行時撞及另外兩輛私家車後不治。
今日（5日）上午約10時37分，警方接報指事主沿東區走廊近北角渡海輪碼頭廣場海濱公園行駛時懷疑失控，撞向另外兩輛私家車。救援人員到場發現事主昏迷，無表面傷痕，由救護車送往律敦治醫院，於中午12時08分證實不治。
一名途經對面線的交通警員目擊意外後掉頭到場，為昏迷的司機進行約三分鐘人工呼吸，其後為救護車開路。初步調查不排除事主駕車時突然不適暈倒，導致車輛失控。
港島總區交通部特別調查隊正跟進調查，呼籲目擊者致電3660 6838或3660 6849提供資料。意外導致東區走廊往中環方向近北角碼頭部分行車線一度封閉，交通擠塞。
